notes_for_us: Best-served prompt in the batch: every clause landed on something. Two of them — "reaches an exit" and "recover me quickly if I fall" — are exactly the step 0 second pile, gameplay rules whose places are gate-escape and checkpoint-respawn, and the skill's instruction to read past the rule to the place worked without strain.

Adventure has no exit row despite Story and Guided Trail presets that plainly terminate somewhere. gate-escape from Survival is the only option in the catalogue that is an exit, and it is worded as a round-win hatch. Adventure's table should carry it.

"Make the objective obvious" is a legibility instruction about how the layout should read, and constraints/build_rule accepted it — but nothing downstream is told to check it, so the only real effect was my choosing tracker-quest and a wide opening route.
